about_the_game:
Main Story:

Upon receiving news of his father's illness, Lin Ye hurriedly returns to his homeland. His mother entrusts him with managing their struggling family guesthouse. Burdened with unpaid debts, Lin Ye must find a way to revive the nearly deserted and poorly functioning guesthouse from its dire situation.

Gameplay:

Through simple and intuitive guesthouse construction and management, players will advance the story by interacting with six main characters, developing unique emotional relationships along the way.

Characters:

Bai Shuang'er: Lin Ye's childhood friend, representing companionship and trust.

Song Xiaoxuan: Cute yet resilient—outwardly delicate but strong at heart.

Chen Yue: Gentle like water, bringing warmth to everyone around her; a symbol of devotion.

Chen Youyou: Rebellious and impulsive, stubborn and competitive, often saying one thing but

meaning another.

Su Yao: A cold-on-the-outside, warm-on-the-inside beauty with a married demeanor.

Michelle: A friend from Lin Ye's study-abroad days, rumored to have looked very different in the past.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content not suitable for all ages: revealing clothing, general adult content with concealed nudity
The game content is purely fictional and all characters are 20 years of age or older.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10/11
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Lin Ye, a graduate who studied abroad, returns home after a failed entrepreneurial venture to inherit his family's business and revive a nearly bankrupt guesthouse. In the process, he meets six girls with different personalities and embarks on a journey with them.
